_comment: ChatGPT for Microsoft 365 add-on (chatgpt-m365). Microsoft Graph delegated scopes on OpenAI's 'ChatGPT' app (e0476654-c1d5-430b-ab80-70cbd947616a), grouped into what ChatGPT can read (readAreas) and what it can change (levels). One app carries every Microsoft connector (Outlook Email, Outlook Calendar, Teams, SharePoint). Scope lists follow OpenAI's help articles 12512241 (Outlook), 12552368 (Teams), 12143177 (SharePoint) and 11509118 (admin permissions), and the grants seen in real tenants in November 2026. writeReads: write scopes that also let ChatGPT read an area, for the 'reading is off but...' warning.

readAreas.label: Email and contacts
readAreas.description: Search and read email and contacts, including shared mailboxes the person can open.

readAreas.label: Calendar
readAreas.description: Read calendars, including shared ones, and find meeting times.

readAreas.label: OneDrive and SharePoint files
readAreas.description: Search and read files and SharePoint sites the person can open.

readAreas.label: Teams chats and channels
readAreas.description: Read Teams chats and channel messages the person can see, the teams and groups they belong to, and colleagues' profiles.

readAreas.label: Teams meetings
readAreas.description: Read online meetings, transcripts and recording details.

readAreas.label: Planner and To Do tasks
readAreas.description: Read the person's tasks and task lists.

levels.summary: Search and read their email, calendar, files, Teams and tasks. Can't change anything.
levels.name: Read only
levels.chatgptActions: Turn off every write action for the Microsoft apps (Outlook Email, Outlook Calendar, Teams, SharePoint).
canDo: Search and read the person's email, contacts, calendar, OneDrive and SharePoint files, Teams chats and meetings, and tasks
Summarise, find information and answer questions about it
cannotDo: Send, change, move or delete anything in Microsoft 365
pros: Lowest risk: nothing in Microsoft 365 can be changed
Ideal for research, catching up on long threads and finding documents
A safe way to start and learn what ChatGPT is useful for
cons: You copy ChatGPT's suggested replies into Outlook yourself
ChatGPT can see everything the person can see, including sensitive mail and files
Something ChatGPT reads, such as a malicious email, could try to influence its answers

levels.summary: Also writes drafts, and moves, labels and deletes email in their own mailbox.
levels.name: Drafts and tidy-up
levels.chatgptActions: Outlook Email: allow only drafting, moving and marking email. Turn off sending, contacts and every Calendar, Teams and SharePoint write action.
canDo: Write draft emails into the person's Drafts folder
Move, label and delete email in the person's own mailbox, for example clearing junk
cannotDo: Change shared mailboxes, calendars, files, Teams or tasks
pros: Saves typing: replies are ready and waiting in Drafts
Nothing leaves the business without the person reviewing it and pressing Send
cons: ChatGPT can move or delete email. Deleted email can be recovered for a limited time, but mistakes are possible
Only the person's own mailbox: ChatGPT can read shared mailboxes but can't tidy them
levels.suits: Most people once they are comfortable with Level 1

levels.summary: Also sends and forwards email, manages meetings, contacts, tasks, out-of-office and mail rules.
levels.name: Personal assistant
levels.tagline: ChatGPT acts on the person's behalf
levels.chatgptActions: Outlook Email and Outlook Calendar: allow the write actions, except anything for shared mailboxes or shared calendars. Teams: allow only Planner tasks. Turn off every SharePoint write action.
canDo: Send and forward email as the person, from their own mailbox
Create, accept and change meetings, including Teams meetings
Manage contacts, Planner and To Do tasks, out-of-office replies and mail rules
cannotDo: Send from or change shared mailboxes and shared calendars
pros: Real time savings: ChatGPT can finish a task, not just prepare it
With the app set to ask first, ChatGPT asks the person to confirm before it sends or changes anything
cons: Email and invites go out in the person's name
A malicious email could try to trick ChatGPT into forwarding information out of the business
Mail rules could redirect email if misused
Relies on the person reading each confirmation carefully
levels.suits: Experienced users who handle a lot of email and diary management

levels.summary: Also sends from shared mailboxes, changes OneDrive and SharePoint files, and posts in Teams.
levels.name: Full access
levels.chatgptActions: Any of the Microsoft apps' actions can be on.
canDo: Send from and change shared mailboxes and shared calendars the person can use
Create, edit, move and delete files in OneDrive and SharePoint that the person can edit, and make sharing links
Post in Teams chats and channels, and start new chats and channels
pros: The most automation: ChatGPT can carry out whole tasks across Microsoft 365
No need to switch between ChatGPT and other apps
cons: Highest risk: ChatGPT could change or delete company files the person can edit, or share them by link
Email from shared mailboxes and messages in Teams go out in the business's or the person's name
A mistake or a manipulated instruction affects shared company data, not just one inbox
We only recommend this with a tested third-party backup in place, and for a small number of people
levels.suits: A few named people, with a third-party backup in place
